name: glove
description: A glove has four fingers, a thumb and a broad cuff.
useCase: Identify full-finger gloves or protective handwear.
misuse: Use mitten for handwear with a shared finger pocket.

16.reason: Four finger pockets and a distinct thumb join the palm above a complete cuff.

24.reason: Four rounded fingers, a separate thumb opening, and a full cuff remain clear inside the square frame.
